```{python}
#| label: fig-cvd-sputter
#| echo: false
#| fig-cap: "Thin-film deposition methods: (a) in chemical vapour deposition (CVD), precursor gases react at the heated wafer surface and deposit a thin film; (b) in sputtering, ions from a plasma knock atoms out of a target, which then condense on the wafer surface."

import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from matplotlib.patches import Rectangle, Circle

fig, axs = plt.subplots(1, 2, figsize=(8, 3.8))

# (a) CVD chamber
ax = axs[0]
ax.add_patch(Rectangle((0.5, 0.5), 8, 6, fc='none', ec='k', lw=1.2))
ax.add_patch(Rectangle((2, 1.0), 5, 0.5, fc='#a0a0a0', ec='k', lw=0.8))
ax.text(4.5, 0.6, 'heated wafer chuck', ha='center', fontsize=8)
ax.add_patch(Rectangle((2.5, 1.5), 4, 0.25, fc='#f5e9d0', ec='k', lw=0.8))
ax.add_patch(Rectangle((2.5, 1.75), 4, 0.12, fc='#3e9c5c', ec='none'))
ax.text(7.0, 1.8, 'film', fontsize=8)
# gas inlet arrows
ax.annotate('', xy=(3.0, 4.0), xytext=(1.0, 5.8),
            arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='->', lw=1.0, color='b'))
ax.annotate('', xy=(4.5, 4.0), xytext=(4.5, 6.0),
            arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='->', lw=1.0, color='b'))
ax.annotate('', xy=(6.0, 4.0), xytext=(8.0, 5.8),
            arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='->', lw=1.0, color='b'))
ax.text(4.5, 6.15, 'precursor gases (e.g., SiH$_4$)', ha='center',
        fontsize=8, color='b')
for x in [3.2, 4.5, 5.8]:
    ax.add_patch(Circle((x, 3.0), 0.12, fc='b', ec='none', alpha=0.6))
ax.set_title('(a) CVD', fontsize=10)
ax.set_xlim(0, 9); ax.set_ylim(0, 7.2)
ax.set_aspect('equal'); ax.axis('off')

# (b) sputtering chamber
ax = axs[1]
ax.add_patch(Rectangle((0.5, 0.5), 8, 6, fc='none', ec='k', lw=1.2))
ax.add_patch(Rectangle((2, 5.4), 5, 0.5, fc='#8f5a2a', ec='k', lw=0.8))
ax.text(4.5, 6.15, 'target (cathode)', ha='center', fontsize=8)
ax.add_patch(Rectangle((2, 1.0), 5, 0.5, fc='#a0a0a0', ec='k', lw=0.8))
ax.add_patch(Rectangle((2.5, 1.5), 4, 0.25, fc='#f5e9d0', ec='k', lw=0.8))
ax.add_patch(Rectangle((2.5, 1.75), 4, 0.12, fc='#8f5a2a', ec='none'))
ax.text(4.5, 0.6, 'wafer (anode)', ha='center', fontsize=8)
# plasma
ax.add_patch(Rectangle((2, 2.6), 5, 2.2, fc='#c9a0dc', ec='none',
                       alpha=0.4))
ax.text(4.5, 3.7, 'Ar plasma', ha='center', fontsize=8, color='#6a2c91')
# ion hitting target, atoms moving down
ax.annotate('', xy=(3.4, 5.4), xytext=(3.4, 4.0),
            arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='->', lw=1.0, color='#6a2c91'))
ax.text(2.9, 4.45, 'Ar$^+$', fontsize=8, color='#6a2c91')
for x in [4.8, 5.6]:
    ax.annotate('', xy=(x, 1.9), xytext=(x - 0.5, 5.3),
                arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='->', lw=1.0, color='#8f5a2a'))
ax.text(6.3, 3.4, 'sputtered\natoms', fontsize=8, color='#8f5a2a')
ax.set_title('(b) Sputtering', fontsize=10)
ax.set_xlim(0, 9); ax.set_ylim(0, 7.2)
ax.set_aspect('equal'); ax.axis('off')

plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()
```
